description: Phase 18 traceability catalog. Numeric detector fixtures live in the named backend test modules; this catalog records their expected meaning and contract.

scenarios.name: vcp-2c-valid
scenarios.reason: Two qualifying contractions progress and the base stays inside configured depth and duration bounds.

scenarios.name: vcp-3c-valid
scenarios.reason: Three successively smaller contractions satisfy VCP progression.

scenarios.name: vcp-4c-valid
scenarios.reason: Four contractions remain within the maximum VCP count.

scenarios.name: vcp-5c-valid
scenarios.reason: Five contractions exercise the inclusive upper-count boundary.

scenarios.name: vcp-expanding-invalid
scenarios.reason: An expanding final contraction retains auditable evidence but invalidates the setup.

scenarios.name: flat-base-valid
scenarios.reason: Repeated support and resistance tests enclose a shallow, flat range.

scenarios.name: flat-base-too-deep
scenarios.reason: Base depth exceeds the configured inclusive maximum.

scenarios.name: 52wh-valid
scenarios.reason: Price persists near the prior 252-session high inside a shallow base.

scenarios.name: 52wh-insufficient-history
scenarios.reason: Fewer than 253 sessions cannot establish a prior 52-week high without look-ahead.

scenarios.name: range-breakout
scenarios.reason: Close clears a confirmed resistance zone with the configured buffer.

scenarios.name: 52wh-breakout
scenarios.reason: Close clears the prior 52-week high using only prior sessions.

scenarios.name: ath-breakout
scenarios.reason: Close clears the full available prior-history high.

scenarios.name: multiyear-breakouts
scenarios.reason: The two-, three-, and five-year variants use their exact prior-session windows.

scenarios.name: failed-breakout
scenarios.reason: Price loses the breakout pivot inside the configured failure window.

scenarios.name: breakout-retest-sequence
scenarios.reason: A linked breakout pulls back to its pivot, holds, and transitions through the retest lifecycle.

scenarios.name: ema20-pullback-valid
scenarios.reason: A stage-two security pulls back to EMA20 and holds its invalidation level.

scenarios.name: ema20-pullback-failure
scenarios.reason: The close loses EMA20 beyond tolerance after a linked pullback.

scenarios.name: sma50-pullback-tiers
scenarios.reason: First, second, and third-plus tests retain stable tier identifiers.

scenarios.name: sma50-pullback-failure
scenarios.reason: The close loses SMA50 beyond tolerance after a linked pullback.

scenarios.name: base-failure
scenarios.reason: A mature base closes below its structural invalidation level.

scenarios.name: structure-failure
scenarios.reason: The confirmed higher-high/higher-low structure breaks below its protected swing low.

scenarios.name: supporting-signal-inventory
scenarios.reason: Every trend, tightness, compression, momentum, and volume identifier has positive and negative fixtures.

scenarios.name: action-adjusted-reliance
scenarios.reason: The official Reliance 1:1 bonus halves pre-ex-date prices and doubles volume under rebuilt-history policy.

scenarios.name: swing-lookahead-trap
scenarios.reason: A pivot is invisible until all configured right-hand trading sessions exist.

scenarios.name: double-bottom-trigger
scenarios.reason: Two similar confirmed swing lows separated by a qualifying neckline become triggered only after the buffered neckline close.

scenarios.name: double-top-ready
scenarios.reason: Two similar confirmed swing highs retain READY evidence until price closes below the buffered neckline.

scenarios.name: completed-interval-only
scenarios.reason: Weekly and monthly detectors aggregate adjusted daily bars and exclude the still-open calendar interval.

scenarios.name: abcd-harmonic
scenarios.reason: Alternating confirmed A-B-C-D swings satisfy configured CD-to-AB equality and BC retracement ranges.
